name: Tides of Hiraeth
source:
A missing god
A haunted prince
And only one second chance

Stoirmaar, god of the wind, has vanished. And Asancur, his secret lover, will do everything in their power to find him. Not that lesser spirits like them have much power to speak of. But by trading their tail and immortality to the exiled goddess of the sea, they just might have a chance.

But what will they do when they learn that the prince who shelters them is more than just a friendly face? And how can Asancur ever hope to find their lover when everyone around them is wearing a mask, themselves included? Ghosts haunt the grounds, devils lurk after dark, and time is running out.

[From [url=https://oraclecanis.itch.io/tides-of-hiraeth]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
失踪的神
一个闹鬼的王子
而且只有一秒钟的机会

风神斯图尔玛已经消失。而他的秘密情人阿桑库尔将竭尽全力寻找他。倒不是说像他们这样的低等神灵有多大的力量可言。但通过将尾巴和不朽卖给被放逐的海洋女神，他们也许还有机会。

但当他们得知庇护他们的王子不仅仅是一张友善的面孔时，他们会怎么做？当周围的每个人都戴着面具（包括他们自己）时，阿桑库尔怎么能指望找到他们的爱人呢？鬼魂出没，魔鬼在天黑后潜伏，时间已经不多了。

[来自[url=https://oraclecanis.itch.io/tides-of-hiraeth]itch.io[/url]]
